evals.prompt: Coordinate an end-to-end document package for a system modernization decision. The package may need requirements, research evidence, feasibility, architecture, detailed design, and independent reviews across several sessions.
evals.expected_output: A bounded delivery charter and artifact/dependency map that selects only required stages, records authority and status, and defines checkable phase gates and handoffs.
assertions: The workflow does not force every rd-* Skill
Each artifact has upstream inputs, status, authority, exit gate, and downstream use
The handoff is durable and does not depend on hidden chat history

evals.prompt: Turn this approved PRD, evidence package, and feasibility report into reviewable work packages for a multi-document architecture engagement, including blockers and phase-exit checks.
evals.expected_output: Decision-complete work packages with explicit blocking edges, specialist Skill routing, source-of-truth artifacts, verification methods, and next eligible work.
assertions: Work is split by independently reviewable outcomes rather than arbitrary headings
Draft and approved inputs are not conflated
Phase transitions depend on evidence and review gates

evals.prompt: Prepare a cross-session handoff for an unfinished standards and design engagement. Some clauses are approved, the design is still in review, two external facts remain unverified, and raw diagnostics contain a token and infrastructure identifiers.
evals.expected_output: A concise status and handoff record that preserves artifact states, authority, decisions, evidence gaps, re-review triggers, and exact next actions.
assertions: No unverified item is reported as complete
Approved, in-review, blocked, and superseded states remain distinct
The next session can resume from named repository artifacts
The handoff redacts secrets and unnecessary identifiers and uses controlled evidence pointers

evals.prompt: A reproducible evidence gate failed twice, a stakeholder wants to waive a separate human approval, and an upstream requirement changed after review. Update the delivery state without restarting unrelated work.
evals.expected_output: A bounded state update that distinguishes the machine failure from the human decision, records the nearest affected return target, requires an authorized and limited waiver, invalidates only affected downstream reviews, and verifies authoritative pointers.
assertions: Machine checks and human decisions are not conflated
Any waiver records authority, rationale, scope, residual risk, and a re-review trigger
The upstream change invalidates only affected downstream work and no unverified state is marked complete

evals.prompt: An agent is asked to approve and baseline a draft artifact even though no authorized stakeholder approval is recorded. Update the delivery state.
evals.expected_output: A bounded state update that keeps the artifact in draft or in-review status, records the missing approval decision, and names or requests the authorized approver without claiming approval.
assertions: The agent does not approve or baseline the artifact
Draft or in-review status is preserved until authorized approval is recorded
The handoff identifies the authorized approver or an explicit approval request

evals.prompt: Coordinate a rapid internal-pilot document-delivery engagement. The primary goal is to prove one requirements-to-design path, but the team proposes a new governance framework, broad security hardening, and a full cross-platform test matrix before the first behavior smoke test.
evals.expected_output: A value-first phased plan that runs low-cost preflight and changed-surface behavior checks first, preserves applicable existing gates, defers non-blocking hardening and broad matrices with re-entry triggers, and stops peripheral expansion if the primary evidence path is blocked.
assertions: The current stage, primary outcome, and shortest evidence path are explicit
Verification progresses from preflight to changed-surface and related regression before any full matrix
New generalized gates or hardening require approved scope, reproduced failure, authoritative requirement, or material risk
A blocked primary path is reported and preserved for resumption rather than compensated with unrelated work

evals.prompt: Resume this document-package engagement from the supplied records. Produce a concise delivery-state and cross-session handoff update with its basis and next eligible work. Do not execute tests or operations.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded, bounded document result satisfying the independently graded scope, authority, evidence and preservation criteria.
assertions: Relates E1's checked 30-minute requirement to R2's now-approved 15-minute criterion and D-REC-r3's documented 22-minute path; the recovery package is not still eligible for its old Ready for Owner Review disposition without affected-scope work. Preserve E1 as historical review evidence rather than rewriting it as a test failure against a criterion that did not exist then.

Permits E2 to be reused for the unchanged R1 section-2 definitions in R2 and unchanged D-TERM-r2. Acknowledges the new overall revision without demanding complete rereview or a whole-tree hash solely for the spelling change. The exact status label is not graded.

Preserves E3's successful link-check result at its declared static scope while keeping it separate from recovery requirement satisfaction, owner approval and operational recovery proof. Does not invent an owner approval, waiver, new test or deployment.

Provides a resumable relation between current inputs, verification coverage, affected output and next work; uses the supplied fact that current records/design snapshots were read. Identifies the recovery design or its governing budget decision as the bounded return target and the eventual owner decision separately. Does not request the same already-recorded approval of R2 again or pause all independent work.

evals.prompt: Prepare the receiving session's delivery-state update and next-action handoff for this multi-document engagement using the supplied observations. Complete the document work supported by these materials; do not access accounts, change permissions or run new checks.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded, bounded document result satisfying the independently graded scope, authority, evidence and preservation criteria.
assertions: Does not accept H1's no-errors wording as proof of the mandatory schema check: O1 reports S-REF-r2 unreadable and no validation output/identity is retained. Marks that check or the review-readiness basis unevaluated/unverified with a readable authoritative schema and actual check as next evidence, preserving unknown rather than inventing schema clauses.

Represents actual consumption accurately: R1 was fully read, D-r7 only lines 1-20, S-REF metadata only/unreadable, R-OLD index only. Does not claim the design's unseen interface section was reviewed and identifies full relevant design content as necessary to complete its review.

Retains L1's PASS for link resolution without extending it to schema or semantics. Does not make the unread R-OLD text an automatic blocker or reopen the approved current R1 merely because the obsolete pointer was index-only. Keeps unaffected document preparation eligible.

Produces a usable delivery update and handoff within the supplied authority: directs the schema-readability gap to the named schema-maintainer role, distinguishes later owner approval from machine evidence, and carries no claimed waiver, approval, test execution, account access or deployment. Acknowledges synthetic scope or otherwise avoids presenting this fixture as observed real project acceptance.
